storyCards.headline: Nightbird: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Stevie Nicks's "Nightbird" reached #33 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Nightbird" is a 1983 song by the American singer-songwriter Stevie Nicks, written by Nicks with Sandy Stewart.

The song peaked at #33 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 12 weeks on the chart.

Nightbird was released in 1983.
